rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_API_Resolve {
    meta:
        description = "Detects dynamic API resolution pattern used by Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        date = "2026-04-11"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        technique = "T1071.001, T1055.012"
    strings:
        $api_hash = { 8B 45 ?? 50 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 04 3D ?? ?? ?? ?? 75 } // Common hash-based API resolution
        $config_marker = "1.0.0.1" wide ascii // Version string in config
        $c2_uri_get = "/index.php" wide ascii
        $c2_uri_post = "/upload.php" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $api_hash and ($config_marker or $c2_uri_get or $c2_uri_post)
}
